short_description: An inadvertent brush with the mob thrusts cabdriver Tommy Angelo into the world of organized crime. Initially uneasy about falling in with the Salieri family, the rewards become too big to ignore.
about: Part one of the Mafia crime saga - 1930s, Lost Heaven, IL  Re-made from the ground up, rise through the ranks of the Mafia during the Prohibition era of organized crime. After a run-in with the mob, cab driver Tommy Angelo is thrust into a deadly underworld. Initially uneasy about falling in with the Salieri crime family, Tommy soon finds that the rewards are too big to ignore.    Play a Mob Movie:  Live the life of a Prohibition-era gangster and rise through the ranks of the Mafia.    Lost Heaven, IL:  Recreated 1930's cityscape, filled with interwar architecture, cars and culture to see, hear and interact with.    Re-Made Classic:  Faithfully recreated, with expanded story, gameplay and original score. This is the Mafia you remembered and much more.      Own  Mafia: Definitive Edition  to unlock Tommy’s Suit and Cab in both  Mafia II and Mafia III Definitive Editions .
